result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Dropbox Sign (formerly HelloSign)** is my top all-round recommendation for e-signature software. It's relatively easy to use, professional, and doesn't require a complicated setup.

However, the best choice depends on how many documents you send, whether you need contracts and approval workflows, and how much you want to spend.

Here are the options I'd shortlist for a UK small business.

## Best e-signature software compared

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Easy to set up and use.
- Templates and signing reminders.
- Good for customer contracts and agreements.
- Particularly useful if you already use Dropbox.
  
  Pricing varies by plan and billing arrangement.
  
  [Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best established business option)

- Widely recognised by customers.
- Strong integrations with business software.
- Templates, signing workflows and audit trails.
- Good for a growing business.
  
  [DocuSign UK website](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Signable**

(Best UK-based option)

- UK-focused e-signature provider.
- Unlimited users on its account-based plans.
- Pay-as-you-go option.
- Particularly attractive for small teams.
  
  [Signable website](https://signable.co.uk/)

**4\. PandaDoc**

(Best for proposals and sales)

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Reusable document templates.
- Electronic signatures and document tracking.
- Useful for businesses sending sales proposals.
  
  [PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

- Excellent PDF integration.
- Good document editing capabilities.

## My recommendation

| Your requirements | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Simple contracts and signatures | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional, established platform | DocuSign |
| UK-based provider and small team | Signable |
| Sales proposals and quotations | PandaDoc |
| PDF editing and signatures | Adobe |


**One important UK consideration\:** Electronic signatures are generally legally admissible in England and Wales, but certain documents have additional formalities. Look for an audit trail, timestamps, signer authentication and secure document storage. search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
